name: Đilasism
summary: Đilasism is the democratic-socialist dissent of Milovan Đilas, a Yugoslav Partisan leader who broke with Tito. It holds that communist party-states create a privileged bureaucratic new class, rejects one-party monopoly and enforced ideology, and calls for a legal democratic socialist opposition, free expression and the separation of party from state.
scope: The Đilas of 1950 to 1995: the Borba articles and 1954 break, The New Class (1957), and his later dissident writing and opposition to Yugoslavia's breakup. Excludes the pre-1953 Đilas as Stalinist and Titoist hardliner and the loose pejorative use of the term. The sources opened give a few core positions in detail; most other statements are inferred. Only the first part of The New Class was read, in Swedish.

sources.title: Milovan Djilas (obituary tribute)
sources.author: Tribune
sources.usedFor: Contemporary tribute: his insistence that denying democracy poisons socialism.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Democratic socialists such as Đilas's admirers favour social provision, but his writings found in sources do not address healthcare; inferred from democratic socialism.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Not discussed by Đilas; inferred from his egalitarian concern about workers being subordinate to a privileged class.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: He attacked bureaucratic control of the economy but remained a socialist; sources give no endorsement of free markets as better than governments.

public-ownership.rationale: He argued that nominal collective ownership is camouflage for bureaucratic ownership, so state ownership alone is not the answer; adherents are split on the form it should take.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: His complaint is the new class's privilege and income; inferred support for curbing high incomes, but taxation is never discussed.

unions-good.rationale: Not discussed directly; inferred from democratic socialism's concern that workers need protection that is independent of the party apparatus.

property-fundamental.rationale: He defines ownership as the right to profit and control and condemns its monopolization; no sources give him a strong rights-based defence of private property.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Corporations are not his subject; his target was the party-state's economic monopoly.

cut-welfare.rationale: Never addressed; democratic socialism opposes cutting welfare.

worker-ownership.rationale: In 1950 he helped formulate workers' self-management, in which workers run enterprises, though he later criticised its bureaucratic implementation.

surveillance-ok.rationale: He was jailed for dissent and criticised the secret police as holding real power in communist states; he would reject surveillance as a justification.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Nothing in the sources bears on drug policy.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: He championed freedom of expression against ideological repression; speech restriction is unaddressed, inferred from that stance.

strong-leader.rationale: He condemned the concentration of power in a party and its leader as the root of communist despotism, and broke with Tito over it.

state-harmful.rationale: He wanted the state and party separated and the state to wither as Marxists hoped, but he did not call it unnecessary and harmful now.

limit-guns.rationale: Firearm regulation appears nowhere in the writings or biographies read, and nothing in his principles points either way.

empower-police-military.rationale: He criticised the secret police and party control of coercive forces; more authority for them runs against his stance.

legalize-sex-work.rationale: Sex work was never a topic for him in the sources read, and democratic socialists divide on it.

decide-locally.rationale: He backed economic decentralisation in 1950 and later floated a loose Yugoslav confederation; local decision-making in general is inferred.

rehabilitation.rationale: Imprisoned twice himself, he wrote against repression; prison philosophy is not discussed, so this is inferred.

traditional-family.rationale: Family structure is absent from his political writing as summarised; no inference is safe.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: The issue post-dates his active career and goes unmentioned; nothing supports a sign.

abortion-legal.rationale: No source has him taking a position on abortion, so this stays neutral.

more-religion-public.rationale: A lifelong communist-turned-socialist with no sourced call for religion in public life; inferred.

correct-racial-injustice.rationale: Racial redress was outside his Yugoslav concerns; no stated view.

gender-social-construct.rationale: Gender theory is absent from everything read about him.

preserve-national-culture.rationale: Mixed: he valued Montenegrin and Serbian literary culture but opposed nationalism; sources give no clear position.

gradual-change.rationale: He accepted that only if the new class gave up its monopolies could change begin, favouring reform of the system over revolution.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Migration policy is not discussed in his writings; no inference.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Only evidence is his backing of UN condemnation of Soviet action in Hungary, too thin to place a view on strengthening the UN.

free-trade.rationale: Trade policy is never discussed in the sources read; neutral.

nation-first.rationale: He opposed the nationalism that broke Yugoslavia in the 1990s, so he would reject putting national interest ahead of cooperation.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: He objected to Soviet intervention but left no view on humanitarian war.

open-borders.rationale: Borders as a theme are absent from the sources; neutral.

limit-growth.rationale: Environmental limits to growth post-date and sit outside his work.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Climate change is anachronistic for his writings; no sourced position.

tech-solves-problems.rationale: Technology as a theme is not in his political writing as summarised.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Energy policy is absent from the sources read.

revolution-justified.rationale: He had led a revolution himself and accepted its role in Russia, China and Yugoslavia, but argued that communist revolutions end in despotism; adherents split.

experts-over-public.rationale: He criticised a bureaucratic elite ruling in the name of knowledge and ideology, so expert rule is rejected by inference.

central-planning.rationale: He described the centralised party-state economy as serving a bureaucratic class and left early on to advocate decentralisation.

socialized-markets.rationale: His 1950 self-management doctrine and decentralisation fit markets among socially owned firms, though he is not documented stating this.

land-value-tax.rationale: Tax theory of this kind is never discussed in his work.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Inferred from his objection to hereditary-style privilege of the new class; not stated.

basic-income.rationale: No evidence he considered unconditional income schemes.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Protectionism is not discussed in anything read.

state-directs-investment.rationale: He argued against bureaucratic control of the economy; direction of investment by officials fits poorly.

widespread-small-property.rationale: He defines ownership by who controls it and opposes monopoly by the bureaucracy, but gives no sourced model of small property.

abolish-money-wages.rationale: Not a stated aim; he disavowed original Marxist utopian predictions.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: No evidence of anti-banking views; as a socialist reformer he would not leave money to the market.

corporatist-bargaining.rationale: State-recognised bodies fixing wages and prices resemble the party-controlled organisations he criticised, though he never addressed corporatism.

one-party-rule.rationale: He wrote that communist single-party monopoly of power, property and ideology is the system's core evil and called in 1954 for a second democratic socialist party.

monarchy-legitimate.rationale: He never discussed monarchy; as a republican Partisan leader and democrat, hereditary headship is inferred as unwelcome.

democracy-best.rationale: The Tribune tribute credits him with insisting that denying democracy poisons socialism; he moved to democratic socialist ideas.

direct-votes.rationale: He wanted multiparty democracy, but no source gives him a view on referendums versus representation.

workers-councils.rationale: He helped devise workers' self-management in 1950, but his later democratic socialism rested on party pluralism rather than councils.

right-to-secede.rationale: He opposed Yugoslavia's breakup, proposing only a loose confederation, so he would not endorse a general right to secede.

natural-rulers.rationale: He attacked a ruling class claiming special entitlement to rule; inferred rejection.

political-violence-never.rationale: He took part in a violent revolution and later opposed Yugoslav violence; no stated absolute.

war-builds-character.rationale: He opposed the nationalist wars of the 1990s; glorifying war is inferred as contrary.

separate-church-state.rationale: Not stated in the sources read; inferred from his secular socialist formation and opposition to enforced ideology.

laws-from-scripture.rationale: A secular socialist who denounced ideological orthodoxy of all kinds; scripture-based law is far from his stance.

private-courts-defense.rationale: Never discussed; privatised justice and defence contradict any socialist outlook.

military-superiority.rationale: Inferred from his criticism of bloc politics and nationalist posturing; not stated.

ethnic-nation.rationale: He opposed 1990s ethnic nationalism and the dissolution of multiethnic Yugoslavia.

class-struggle-history.rationale: He retained Marxist class analysis, naming a new exploiting class, but said Marx's concrete predictions failed.

equal-outcomes.rationale: He valued equality and condemned privilege, but in doubting Marxist utopias gave no sourced stance on equality of outcomes.

indigenous-land-authority.rationale: Indigenous rights are outside his documented concerns.

colonial-reparations.rationale: Reparations never come up in what I read.

civilizational-union.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to nationalist and ethnic blocs; not stated.

self-interest-moral.rationale: Socialist moral outlook points against celebrating self-interest, though he never addressed the claim.

duties-before-rights.rationale: He criticised the communist system for securing no individual rights; the Tribune notes his insistence on democracy.

nature-intrinsic-value.rationale: Environmental philosophy is absent from the sources read.

limit-population.rationale: Population policy is not discussed in what I read.

industrial-civilization-disaster.rationale: He accepted industrialisation as the setting of communist revolutions and never rejected it.

accelerate-technology.rationale: Technology disruption is not a theme in his writing as summarised.

human-enhancement.rationale: Transhumanist topics are anachronistic and absent.

algorithmic-government.rationale: Anachronistic; inferred from opposition to technocratic bureaucracy.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Inferred from a dissident's need for private communication against a secret police.

restore-past-order.rationale: He broke with the past order but also doubted utopias; inferred rejection of restoration.

results-over-ideology.rationale: His critique is that ideology became dogma; he disliked orthodoxy, but judged by principle too.

direct-action.rationale: He favoured legal reform and publishing dissent rather than street action; inferred.

means-match-ends.rationale: Central to his argument that revolution's despotic means produced a despotic outcome.

return-to-foraging.rationale: Nothing he wrote suggests it; his analysis assumes industrial societies.

abolish-division-of-labor.rationale: He abandoned orthodox Marxist expectations; not stated.

distribute-by-need.rationale: He retained the ideals of equality and brotherhood but doubted communist utopian promises.

production-for-use.rationale: Not stated; split between his early self-management and later pluralist views.

profit-exploitation.rationale: He argued exploitation now lies in the bureaucracy's control of surplus, not private profit alone.

dictatorship-of-proletariat.rationale: He wrote that Lenin's hopes for a free classless society via dictatorship failed and led to despotism.

collective-farming.rationale: Not addressed in the sources; inferred from his rejection of coercive Stalinist-model collectivisation and support for decentralisation.

capitalism-causes-war.rationale: His writing targets communist states; the sources do not give his view on capitalism and imperialism.

taxation-theft.rationale: Not discussed; a libertarian view is alien to a democratic socialist.

harm-principle.rationale: Inferred from his demand for individual rights and freedom of thought against enforced uniformity.

individual-rights-only.rationale: He wanted individual rights secured but sources give no view on group rights.

conscription.rationale: Military service policy is absent from the sources read.

exit-over-voice.rationale: He valued democratic voice over exit; inferred.

state-as-business.rationale: Not discussed; treating citizens as customers cuts against socialist and democratic citizenship.

positive-liberty.rationale: He cared for material equality and freedom together; not explicitly stated.

media-academia-power.rationale: His target was party control of media and education, not a hidden academic power; inferred disagreement.

hereditarian-race.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his universalist socialism and anti-nationalism.

organic-representation.rationale: Inferred from preference for party pluralism and parliamentary democracy.

total-state.rationale: He described the communist state as directing every sphere, demanding uniformity in political, philosophical and moral views, and condemned it.

national-rebirth.rationale: He opposed the radical nationalism of the 1990s Yugoslav breakup.

territorial-expansion.rationale: He opposed the nationalist wars of Yugoslavia's breakup.

personal-loyalty-rule.rationale: Rule by personal loyalty is the reverse of the legal, democratic order he sought.

bound-labor.rationale: Serfdom-like obligations contradict every part of his thought on equality and workers' freedom.

no-neutral-knowledge.rationale: He held that dogma was used to cloak power but sought honest critique; inferred.

universal-morality.rationale: His writings as summarised do not take a view on moral universals.

single-common-good.rationale: He criticised an ideology claiming a single correct line, preferring a plural democratic politics.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Zionism is not addressed in any source read.

workplace-democracy.rationale: He co-formulated workers' self-management in 1950; democratic control of firms was a founding aim.

school-vouchers.rationale: Education finance is not addressed in the sources.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Macroeconomic policy is not addressed in the sources.

economic-freedom.rationale: He argued political freedom needs an end to the party's monopoly of property and power, but did not link it to market freedom as such.

rule-by-example.rationale: He attacked rulers' moral claims; law and plural politics preferred.

national-self-determination.rationale: He believed nations could seek independence from the Soviet Union but opposed Yugoslavia's dissolution; split.

force-without-un.rationale: He backed international condemnation of the Soviet invasion of Hungary; unilateral force is inferred as unwelcome.

reason-over-faith.rationale: Not addressed in the sources read; adherents are not documented either way.

welfare-for-citizens.rationale: Inferred from his universalist and anti-nationalist outlook; not discussed.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Welfare conditions are not discussed in the sources.

class-collaboration.rationale: He kept class analysis of the new class, so collaboration with it is unlikely.

sacrifice-heritage.rationale: He was a writer and literary figure; inferred rejection.

dominated-front.rationale: He disliked bloc politics, preferring independence from both Soviet and Western blocs; a common front is inferred as unlikely.

workers-nation.rationale: He abandoned orthodox Marxist expectations yet opposed nationalism; organising workers along national lines is inferred as unwelcome.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: Inferred from egalitarian socialism; not stated.

ban-interest.rationale: Not discussed; no sign of religious or Proudhonist views.

racial-segregation-law.rationale: Inferred from universalist socialism; strongly against by any reading.

state-class-instrument.rationale: He argued that in communist states the party-state itself served the new ruling class, extending the Marxist view of the state.

assimilate-immigrants.rationale: Migration and assimilation are not discussed.

elite-replacement.rationale: Conspiratorial claims of this kind contradict his materialist analysis of elites.

proportional-representation.rationale: He backed multiparty democracy but not any electoral formula.

national-mission.rationale: He criticised Soviet export of its system and the nationalism of the 1990s; a national mission to spread a system is inferred as rejected.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: Gender structure analysis is absent from the sources.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: His central theme was that the party elite enjoys material privileges and monopoly while claiming to represent workers.

heritable-defect-limits.rationale: Eugenics is inconsistent with his equality and rights stance; not discussed.

security-forces-accountable.rationale: Inferred from his dissident criticism of the secret police.

night-watchman-state.rationale: A minimal state is contrary to democratic socialism, though not stated by him.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: He valued equality and brotherhood and demanded individual rights against party privilege.

socialism-one-country.rationale: He rejected Soviet domination, but sources do not give his view on whether socialism survives in one country.

settler-state-colonial.rationale: Settler colonialism was not a topic in the sources.

uniform-civil-code.rationale: Not discussed; Yugoslavia's religious law questions are absent from the sources.

no-religion-state-schools.rationale: Not stated; inferred sympathy with secular schooling is offset by his opposition to enforced atheism.

state-strengthens-encirclement.rationale: He held the state should separate from the party and wither, and he criticised the Stalinist justification for strengthening it.

consent-of-governed.rationale: The Tribune credits his belief that denial of democracy poisons socialism; democratic legitimacy follows.

population-transfer.rationale: He opposed the ethnic nationalism and violence of the 1990s Yugoslav wars.

initiating-force-wrong.rationale: He fought as a Partisan commander and later criticised violence; no absolute principle is documented.

competition-drives-progress.rationale: Inferred from his socialist and humanist outlook; not discussed.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: He called for opposition parties to be allowed; banning could be accepted only by exception; inferred.

freedom-as-non-domination.rationale: Inferred from his critique of arbitrary rule by party officials.

separated-powers.rationale: He held party and state should be separated, and favoured pluralism and rule of law in place of party monopoly.

vanguard-party.rationale: He argued that the Leninist disciplined minority party turned into a ruling class of bureaucracy and centralised despotism.

priority-to-poor.rationale: Inferred from his egalitarian socialism; not stated directly.

right-to-buy-council-homes.rationale: British housing policy is far from his concerns.

restrict-strikes-picketing.rationale: Inferred from sympathy for workers; not addressed.

population-causes-poverty.rationale: Not discussed; he blamed institutions, specifically bureaucratic privilege, for inequality.

diversity-weakens-cohesion.rationale: He defended multiethnic Yugoslavia against nationalist breakup.

offices-by-lottery.rationale: Sortition is not discussed in the sources.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: He was imprisoned under such powers and opposed secret-police rule.

price-controls-essentials.rationale: Not discussed; his writings on economic control focus on the party monopoly.

party-controls-media.rationale: Publications such as Beseda and Revija 57 were suppressed as Đilasist, and he fought ideological repression; he himself broke with party media control in 1954.

party-commands-army.rationale: His party/state separation implies the army should be a state body, not party-commanded.

representatives-worker-pay.rationale: He condemned official privileges and salaries but made no sourced proposal.

party-discipline-binding.rationale: He urged looser party discipline after 1954.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Supranational integration is not addressed in the sources, though he favoured loose confederation for Yugoslavia.

head-commands-forces.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to one-man rule.

clerical-rule.rationale: Rule by clerics is inferred as opposed to his secular, democratic commitments.

defeat-own-government-war.rationale: Not discussed; he was a nationally committed Partisan in the second world war.

censor-art-for-virtue.rationale: He was himself a writer persecuted for publications and opposed ideological censorship.

unlimited-reelection.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to concentrated, entrenched power; not stated.

recall-officials.rationale: Inferred from accountability emphasis; not stated.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Alliance policy is not discussed in the sources.

abolish-rental-housing.rationale: Not discussed; compulsory home ownership has no socialist or democratic grounding.

educated-out-of-touch.rationale: He was an intellectual and writer; inferred.

death-penalty.rationale: Not discussed; having been imprisoned for dissent, he is inferred to be wary of the state's power to kill.

creationism-in-schools.rationale: Inferred from a secular rationalist formation; not discussed.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Inferred from his rejection of ethnic definition of the nation; not discussed.

minority-language-support.rationale: Inferred from his multiethnic Yugoslav setting.

encourage-eccentricity.rationale: His call for freedom of thought against enforced uniformity extends to moral conformity.

independence-needs-economic-change.rationale: Not discussed; his own national-communist analysis of satellite states was about Soviet domination.

restrict-freedoms-for-growth.rationale: He argued communist industrialisation sacrificed freedom to a privileged class and that freedom, not just growth, was the aim.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Inferred from his non-bloc, anti-nationalist outlook; not stated.

no-land-for-peace.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to ethnic territorial claims.

property-serves-common-good.rationale: His view of ownership as the right to profit and control is functional; inferred.

soviet-state-capitalist.rationale: Đilasism rejected Stalinism as totalitarian, imperialist and state capitalist; he later said the bureaucracy forms a new class.

annexed-territory-occupation.rationale: His support for Hungary in 1956 hints at sympathy for unconsented subjugation, but he gave no general view on annexation.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: He opposed ideological uniformity, but the sources do not give a view on curbing churches.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: He opposed breakup but also the 1990s wars; he suggested loose confederation, so force is not endorsed.

region-keeps-system.rationale: His confederation suggestion hints at autonomy but not on economic systems.

sacred-ruler.rationale: He condemned leader cults and the privileged class around the ruling party.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Inferred from egalitarian socialism; not stated.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: He argued that in communist states state power rests with party committees and secret police regardless of formal law, and condemned it.

leader-cult.rationale: He denounced the party leadership's privilege and single-leader rule in Yugoslavia.

class-struggle-under-socialism.rationale: He argued a new exploiting class emerges within socialism itself from party bureaucracy.

land-redistribution.rationale: Not discussed; Yugoslav land reform of the 1940s is not addressed in the sources read.

co-ethnic-territorial-claim.rationale: He opposed the nationalist territorial wars of the 1990s.

apostasy-punishable.rationale: He opposed enforced ideological and moral uniformity.

women-must-cover.rationale: Inferred from his secular outlook and defence of personal freedom; not discussed.

kin-peoples-union.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to ethnic nationalism; not stated.

material-conditions-drive-history.rationale: He said Marx's concrete predictions proved wrong while keeping materialist class analysis; split.

courts-bound-by-majority.rationale: He wanted rights secured against party power, implying constraints on majorities; inferred.

economic-self-sufficiency.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his pluralist, open outlook.

moral-incentives.rationale: He pointed to the new class's material privileges as the reality behind socialist ideals.

armed-group-creates-revolution.rationale: He noted communist revolutions were by small minorities, an approach he led in Yugoslavia and later condemned in effect.

abolish-hereditary-privilege.rationale: Inferred from his attack on privilege of a ruling class.

civilizing-tutelage.rationale: Inferred from his anti-domination stance towards Soviet satellite control and egalitarianism.

patriotic-education.rationale: Inferred from his anti-nationalism and opposition to ideological schooling; not stated.

capitalism-adapts.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; he said Marx's concrete predictions failed, which weakly suggests adaptation.

former-empire-influence.rationale: Inferred from his criticism of Soviet domination; not discussed.

delink-world-market.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his non-autarkic stance.

freedom-to-discriminate.rationale: Inferred from his egalitarian commitments; not discussed.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: He stressed that communist systems secure no individual rights; entrenched protections follow from his democratic turn.

elective-rulers.rationale: Democratic socialism requires chosen rulers; inferred from his championing democracy.

minority-veto.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his support for majoritarian democracy with protection of individual rights.

resist-lawless-ruler.rationale: He resisted Tito's party leadership through public dissent; inferred.

parliament-supreme.rationale: He backed multiparty democracy but did not specify a constitutional model.

noblesse-oblige.rationale: Inferred from his criticism of privileged classes; not discussed.

withdraw-from-politics.rationale: He persisted in political writing despite imprisonment.

ruling-class-consent.rationale: He says the new class relies on ideological uniformity and the secret police, not only consent.

native-born-offices.rationale: Inferred from universalism and anti-nationalism; not discussed.

party-own-road.rationale: Đilasism began as a breakaway from Titoism criticising the Soviet Union and Stalinism, and national paths to socialism are central to the Yugoslav deviation.

antifascism-founding-value.rationale: A Partisan commander; anti-fascism was his wartime cause.

totalitarianisms-equivalent.rationale: He called Yugoslavia totalitarian in 1954 and condemned communism as a failure.

institutions-fit-civilization.rationale: Inferred from his democratic socialism, which he held as universal; not stated.

military-guardian-role.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his opposition to unaccountable coercive power.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Inferred from socialist preference for collective provision; not discussed.

single-official-language.rationale: Inferred from his multiethnic Yugoslav setting.

consumerism-harmful.rationale: Not discussed, though he criticised the privileges and possessions of the new class.

arm-foreign-insurgents.rationale: Inferred from his criticism of Soviet interference; not discussed.

intervene-in-bloc.rationale: He supported the Hungarian Revolution against Soviet intervention and objected to Yugoslavia's abstention on the UN vote, which led to his 1956 arrest.

corporate-influence.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; his target was party power.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: He published abroad and was jailed for it in 1962; inferred.

no-duty-to-obey.rationale: Not discussed in the sources; he broke party discipline but respected rule of law as a demand.

non-intervention.rationale: He backed international condemnation of Soviet intervention in Hungary.

minority-conspiracy.rationale: Conspiracy theories about minorities are inconsistent with his analysis and his universalism.

abolish-legal-marriage.rationale: Not discussed; no sign of radical positions on marriage.

public-access-to-information.rationale: Inferred from his battle for free publication against the party monopoly.

informal-organisation.rationale: He advocated a legal opposition party, not informal groups.

religious-nation.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to religious and ethnic nationalism; not stated.

deference-to-leading-power.rationale: He denounced Soviet domination of satellite states.

personal-possessions-private.rationale: Not discussed; the standard socialist distinction between personal and productive property is inferred.

defeat-communism.rationale: He called communism a relic, but as a democratic socialist he favoured reform and engagement, not a campaign.

religion-illusion.rationale: Not discussed in the sources read.

purge-loanwords.rationale: Inferred from anti-nationalism and his literary cosmopolitanism; not discussed.

majority-settlement.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to ethnic nationalism.

neither-capitalism-nor-communism.rationale: He rejected communism and remained a democratic socialist, which is a third course.

historical-land-claim.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to ethnic territorial claims in the 1990s.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Not discussed; as an anti-fascist Partisan commander he is inferred to reject it.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from opposition to state repression of private life, though attitudes in his era were conservative.

suppress-opposition.rationale: He argued that communist rule excludes rival groups and called for opposition and a democratic socialist party.

punish-blasphemy.rationale: He opposed enforced ideological and moral uniformity.

colonies-serve-metropole.rationale: Inferred from his egalitarian, anti-domination stance; not discussed.

unreligious-rulers-fought.rationale: Inferred from secular outlook; not discussed.

participatory-democracy.rationale: His 1950 self-management doctrine involved participation; later focus was party pluralism.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Not discussed; he remained on the democratic left.

divine-source-of-authority.rationale: Inferred from secular democratic outlook; not discussed.

social-market-economy.rationale: Not discussed; between his early self-management ideas and later democratic socialism, adherents could go either way.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Not discussed; a Partisan veteran with no pacifist record.

rich-first.rationale: He condemned privileged elites in communist systems.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: Yugoslav deviationism rejected subordination to the Soviet bloc; inferred for non-alignment.

dynastic-succession.rationale: Inferred from his criticism of the class privilege passed to the party elite.

property-franchise.rationale: Inferred from his democratic principles; not discussed.

press-owned-by-wealth.rationale: Not discussed; his own battle was against the party's monopoly of press, not private wealth.

promulgated-standing-laws.rationale: He criticised rule by party committees and secret police over formal law.

racial-franchise.rationale: Inferred from his democratic principles; not discussed.

open-government-data.rationale: Inferred from his demand for free press against party secrecy.

interfaith-marriage-restriction.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to enforced religious and ideological uniformity.

boycott-minority-shops.rationale: Inferred from his rejection of ethnic nationalism; not discussed.

wealth-concentration-endangers-liberty.rationale: He argued that concentrating property, understood as control, in one class endangers freedom; here the owners are the bureaucracy.

state-promotes-atheism.rationale: He opposed enforced ideological uniformity in philosophy and morals.

abolish-police-prisons.rationale: Not discussed; no sign of abolitionist views.

power-sharing-divided-societies.rationale: He proposed a loose Yugoslav confederation but gave no explicit view on power-sharing.

charity-over-state-aid.rationale: Inferred from socialist preference for public provision; not discussed.

uniformed-youth.rationale: Inferred from his rejection of regimentation and ideological uniformity.

income-for-work-not-ownership.rationale: His critique is that the new class takes the largest share of workers' gains through control, not work.

never-kill-self-defence.rationale: Not discussed; a Partisan veteran is not a pacifist.

martyrs-honoured.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to nationalist cults; not discussed.

politics-spiritual-struggle.rationale: Inferred from his secular rationalism; not discussed.

economy-in-majority-hands.rationale: Inferred from opposition to ethnic nationalism; not discussed.

independent-unions.rationale: He argued the party dominates all organisations in communist states; independence from party follows.

socialism-needs-workers-power.rationale: He held that in communist states the working class is dominated by a bureaucracy, so the name socialism is hollow without it.

confederal-coordination.rationale: He suggested loose confederation for Yugoslavia but not city confederations.

online-anonymity.rationale: Inferred from dissident need to publish without reprisal.

person-over-state.rationale: He criticised communism for securing no individual rights; the individual should not be sacrificed.

racial-group-interests.rationale: Inferred from his universalism and opposition to ethnic politics; not discussed.

defensive-wars-only.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to the 1990s wars of conquest; not stated.

language-defines-nation.rationale: Inferred from anti-nationalism and Yugoslavism; not stated.

communal-electorates.rationale: Inferred from his opposition to ethnic politics; not discussed.

foreign-partition-plot.rationale: Not discussed; he warned that internal bureaucratic nationalism would break Yugoslavia, not foreign plots.

smash-state-machine.rationale: His reform path is conditional on the new class yielding monopolies; smashing the state is a communist revolutionary idea he revised.

sacred-nation.rationale: He opposed nationalism that broke Yugoslavia.

public-service-media.rationale: Inferred from his demand for independent publication free of party control.

workers-own-party.rationale: He called for a new democratic socialist party in 1954, but not specifically a workers' party.

ban-fgm.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from his rights-based democratic socialism.

women-property-inheritance.rationale: Not discussed; inferred from egalitarian socialism and his movement's legal equality for women.

one-language-many-names.rationale: Not discussed in the sources, though he called himself a Serb late in life.

customary-chiefs-lawmaking.rationale: Inferred from his democratic outlook; not discussed.

environment-over-liberty.rationale: Inferred from his priority on freedom; not discussed.

religious-equal-recognition.rationale: Inferred from his rejection of ideological orthodoxy.

democracy-is-procedure.rationale: Not discussed; his democracy included rights and pluralism beyond elections, but the sources do not frame it either way.

internet-shutdowns.rationale: Anachronistic; inferred from his lifelong fight against suppression of information.

women-suffrage.rationale: He was a Partisan commander and communist leader whose movement granted women suffrage; inferred.

homestead-ownership.rationale: Inferred from socialist views on property; not discussed.

scripture-inerrant.rationale: Inferred from secular outlook; not discussed.

defend-planned-state.rationale: He argued the planned party-state is a bureaucratic class system, so defending it as such is contrary.

indirect-election.rationale: Inferred from his preference for direct multiparty democracy over delegate selection under party control.

national-church-status.rationale: Inferred from his secular outlook; not discussed.

minority-territorial-autonomy.rationale: Inferred from his multiethnic Yugoslav setting.

missingStatements.text: A ruling party's officials form a privileged class that lives off the labour of the people they claim to represent.
missingStatements.rationale: The central thesis of The New Class is that the party bureaucracy of communist states is a new exploiting class through its control of property.

missingStatements.text: Public ownership of an economy is a disguise for control by a bureaucracy unless the public holds real democratic power.
missingStatements.rationale: Djilas called collective ownership camouflage for the political bureaucracy's real ownership.

missingStatements.text: A single party should not hold a monopoly over the state, the economy and ideology, even if it calls itself socialist.
missingStatements.rationale: He demanded an end to the new class's monopolies of property, ideology and power, and in 1954 called for a second democratic socialist party.

notes: Evidence is concentrated on one-party rule, party monopoly, revolution and the bureaucratic new class. Most other answers are low-confidence inferences, so the profile is likely to be thin on salience. His early self-management work and later pluralism differ in emphasis.
